title: spec/appendix-ccp12-hopping.md: Out-of-bounds channel index when NChannels <= 2
description:
The formula '1 + (Hash MOD MAX(NChannels-1, 2))' returns channel indices 1 or 2 when NChannels <= 2. For NChannels=2, valid channels are 0 and 1, so channel 2 is out-of-bounds. For NChannels=1, both 1 and 2 are invalid. The spec does not document a minimum NChannels requirement.

Fix suggestion: Either document that NChannels must be >= 3, or change the formula to clamp the result: 'RETURN MIN(1 + (Hash MOD N), NChannels - 1)' or use 'N = MAX(NChannels - 1, 1)' and accept single-channel data operation.
